scenario_definition.oracle_query: Find an existing commercial unit to assess a conversion into a play space / baby parking (hourly childcare) for 15 children, subject to confirmation of the applicable authorization regime in Turin with at least 115 sqm of gross floor area in energy class D or better near parks.

clarifications.D: I intend to assess a conversion into a play space / baby parking (hourly childcare), subject to confirmation of the applicable authorization regime.
clarifications.L: I have no requirement on the specific city or location.
clarifications.Cb: I have no requirement on commercial floor area or child occupancy limits for the play space.
clarifications.Ce: I prefer a property in energy class D or better.

requirements.description: Preferred energy class D or better.
Prefers properties near parks; threshold is rounded from the green category's 75th percentile (89.49).

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Commercial activities and similar' AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D') AND green >= 89 ORDER BY id ASC
